current-block: Testing if access token was revoked after authorization code reuse (the AS 'should' have revoked the access token)
comment: This AS issues stateless, self-contained JWT access tokens verified by signature/exp alone (see resource/verify.go) - there is no revocation list a resource endpoint could consult. Detecting authorization-code reuse and additionally revoking the access token it already issued is a SHOULD (RFC 6749 4.1.2), not a MUST, and the suite's own module text confirms failing to do it will not block certification. See FAPIgo's conversation history / ARCHITECTURE.md for the tradeoff (stateless verification vs. a shared revocation store).
